title: OpenDiffraction: Synthetic CDI Patterns
subtitle: Physics-based coherent diffraction images with ground truth and benchmarks
description: OpenDiffraction is a physics-based synthetic dataset for coherent diffraction imaging (CDI) and phase retrieval benchmarking. Fully reproducible and compatible with DPR (Nature Comms / npj Comp Mat 2025). GitHub Repository: https://github.com/KindlyGentleman/opendiffraction
